title: vnstock_metadata_snapshot Evidence Platform Registry handoff record
description: Shape of ONE ticker x field provenance record for the vnstock_metadata_snapshot sub-source (the `metadata` table in vn_stock.db, written by stock-core-private/meta_sync.py). Forward-looking ingestion contract only: no Evidence Platform Registry exists in this workspace yet. Same contract as operations-review/evidence/subsource-freshness-metadata-refresh-closeout-20260727-125051/vnstock_metadata_snapshot_registry_handoff.schema.json, restructured to inline the three nested objects (timestamps, raw_hash, freshness_sla) instead of $defs/$ref: this repo's validator (builders/validate_json_schema_subset.py) does not resolve $ref, and none of these three sub-objects is reused elsewhere in this schema, so inlining loses no deduplication value while making every constraint (including the fail-closed raw_hash/provider_timestamp pins) actually enforced by validate().

source.description: Logical sub-source name -- matches the `source=` provenance tag already used by ai-core-private/builders/build_ticker_context.py for these same fields.

provider.description: The literal upstream call meta_sync.py makes for this field, or the manual/derived origin when the value is not a direct provider passthrough.

value.description: The parsed scalar as currently persisted in metadata.<field>. Null is preserved as-is (never coerced to 0/blank); dividend_yield's historical -1 sentinel ("queried, no value") is passed through unchanged, never reinterpreted as data.

observed_at.description: meta_sync.py's local job clock at the moment the per-ticker write committed (metadata.updated).

effective_at.description: Equal to observed_at for live/point-in-time fields. For KBS ratio fields (pe/pb/roe/dividend_yield) this is only an approximation of the scrape moment -- see timestamp_basis.

provider_timestamp.description: Always null today: no vnstock endpoint used by meta_sync.py exposes a provider-asserted timestamp. Must never be back-filled with observed_at.

raw_payload_retained.description: meta_sync.py never retains the raw provider response; a per-field raw hash cannot be computed, including retroactively.

transform_version.description: First 12 hex chars of sha256(stock-core-private/meta_sync.py) at the time the record was produced.

qualification_status.description: Reuses ai-core-private/builders/missing_data_contract.py's MetricStatus vocabulary. Describes vnstock_metadata_snapshot's own pipeline, not the hash-gated PDF evidence-qualification pipeline.

distinct_from.description: Populated only for roe and shares_outstanding: names the financial-statement-derived counterpart(s) this value must never be aliased with.
